Frontend hosting: projects, deployments, domains and logs through the Vercel REST API.

## API key

1. Open [vercel.com](https://vercel.com/account/tokens) and create an API key with only the access your apps need.
2. Copy it. It may be shown only once.

**What to create:** An access token from your account's Tokens page.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add vercel
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  vercel: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls Vercel's [API](https://vercel.com/docs/rest-api) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. Use `"write"` if the app changes things. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show vercel` shows the key as set.

**Rate limits:** Limits are per action (deployments, domains, teams), listed on Vercel's limits page.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Vercel).
